limits: Three clean read-speech samples; not representative WER/CER, code-mix/noise, p95 or voice approval. Request time includes network/upload/queue/inference, not model compute RTF.
normalization: NFC + casefold + decimal-digit normalization; punctuation/symbols become whitespace. WER uses words; CER counts Unicode code points with whitespace removed, not grapheme clusters.
model_identity_limit: Models are identified by public Space source/configuration, not attested immutable runtime weight hashes.
